subject: Scheduling: VPC / On‑Prem Architecture Deep Dive (networking, IAM, security)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@acme-health.com>, Lisa Park <lisa.park@acme-health.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-12 09:05 AM PDT
Subject: VPC / On‑Prem Architecture Deep Dive — scheduling

Hi Tom & Lisa,

Following up from our discovery session last week — thanks again for the context. The engineering team here would like to run a focused architecture deep dive to validate the VPC/on‑prem connectivity and IAM plans before the pilot. Attendees we propose:

- Tom & Lisa (Acme Health) — infra / platform engineers
- Procurement representative (for any network procurement or third‑party license questions)
- Dev Patel (Redwood SE) — lead for integration design
- Vivek Kulkarni (Redwood infra lead) — operational constraints and SRE questions
- Evelyn Hart (Redwood security) — security controls and audit scope

Suggested agenda (45–60 min):
1) Quick intros & scope (5 min)
2) Current network topology and connectivity options (VPC peering, VPN, private link) (15 min)
3) On‑prem connector / firewall rules, IP ranges, and expected egress patterns (15 min)
4) IAM and service account model, least privilege recommendations (10 min)
5) Next steps & action items (5–10 min)

Propose two 1‑hour slots next week (all times PDT):
- Wed 2026‑04‑14 10:00–11:00
- Thu 2026‑04‑15 08:00–09:00

If neither works, please send 2 windows that fit your team and procurement/security will be looped in. Also, if you can share your current network diagram and any IP ranges ahead of time that would help Dev prep.

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555‑0123

Attachments: redwood_vpc_arch_slide.pdf (preview), redwood_security_checklist.xlsx (preview)

From: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@acme-health.com>

Cc: Lisa Park <lisa.park@acme-health.com>, procurement@acme-health.com
Date: 2026-04-12 10:12 AM PDT
Subject: Re: VPC / On‑Prem Architecture Deep Dive — scheduling

Hi Marissa,

Thanks — both proposed slots look promising but I need to confirm with our security lead (Sarah) and procurement. Tentatively Thu 04/15 08:00 PDT works best for the infra team (Tom, Lisa).

One ask from our side: can we include a short section on data residency and audit logs (SOC2 / retention) in the agenda? Our security reviewer will likely want to see where logs are stored and how long they’re retained.

I'll confirm by end of day and loop Sarah in. Also attaching our current network export (we'll send a cleaned diagram) — expect an updated diagram by EOD tomorrow.

Cheers,
Tom

+1 (206) 555‑7789

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@acme-health.com>, Lisa Park <lisa.park@acme-health.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-12 12:00 PM PDT
Subject: Re: VPC / On‑Prem Architecture Deep Dive — proposed agenda and prep

Thanks Tom — that sounds great. A couple of technical prep items from our side so the call is productive:

- Please share the cleaned network diagram (VLANs, firewalls, NATs) and current public IP ranges.
- Confirm whether you prefer: VPC Peering, VPN (site‑to‑site), or a PrivateLink style connection — we'll show tradeoffs.
- For IAM: do you plan to use cross‑account roles, OIDC provider, or long‑lived service accounts? If you have an example policy, paste it into the Confluence page.
- Any Egress / Proxy gateways we need to be aware of (ports allowed outbound, IP allowlist for the connector).

We'll cover: kernel‑level NAT behaviour we observe with the on‑prem connector, KV cache security expectations, and required firewall rules. If you can upload the diagram to the Confluence page linked below it will save time.

Proposed small pre‑read (short): redwood_vpc_arch_slide.pdf (contains options matrix).

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference

Related link: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/ACME/VPC+Integration+Notes
